“The Paradise” Cast Breaks Tradition, Engages Media Directly at Mumbai Press Meet

Mumbai recently hosted the press meet for the film “The Paradise,” attended by lead actors Nani, Sonali Kulkarni, Kayadu Lohar, and Raghav Juyal. The event distinguished itself from typical Pan-India film promotions, which often see actors responding to pre-arranged questions from a host. In a rare move, the cast of “The Paradise” decided to open the floor to direct questions from the attending media.

This shift in format allowed for a more dynamic interaction between the stars and journalists. As anticipated, actor Nani was a central figure in the discussions. He shared a personal cinematic preference, naming “Baazigar” as his “favourite commercial film.” Nani also drew laughter with a quip about Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan, stating, “Shah Rukh Khan and I have the EXACT same measurements; wish we had the same PAYMENT as well!”

The candid exchange provided a unique glimpse into the cast's approach to promoting “The Paradise.” By engaging directly with the press, the team fostered an environment of open dialogue, diverging from the more controlled settings often seen in such events. This interactive format was a key highlight of the Mumbai press gathering.

What to watch: Look for “The Paradise” to experience the film and its unique promotional approach.
